values: 被动地，特弥希娅会在战场上冲锋，对路径上的敌人造成伤害；主动释放时，向前跳跃，对周围敌人造成伤害和击倒，并提高自身冲锋的速度。

Passive. Temesia charges on the battlefield, dealing damage to all enemies on her path. 
Active. Temesia summons her mount to leap forward, dealing damage and knocking adjacent enemies down, and increasing her charge speed.

被动地，特弥希娅不会进行普通攻击，而是会选择一名最远的敌人向其冲锋，撞击路径上的所有敌人，造成125% + 10% ATK伤害，在抵达目标位置后掉转方向并回复180点能量。攻击速度和急速不会影响特弥希娅的动作速度，每1点攻击速度或急速使得自身冲锋伤害提高1%。
使用终极技能时，战马“晨曦”向前跳跃，对自身1格范围的敌人造成300% ATK伤害并击倒，随后使自身冲锋速度永久提高10%，最多叠加2次。

Passive. Temesia does not perform normal attacks. Instead, she selects the farthest enemy and charges towards them, dealing 125% + 10% ATK damage to all enemies in her path. Upon reaching the target, she changes direction and restores 180 Energy. Temesia's attack animation speed is not affected by her ATK SPD or Haste. Each point of ATK SPD or Haste increases her charge damage by 1%.
Active. Temesia summons her mount Dawn to leap forward, dealing 300% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them down. Her charge speed will be increased by 10% afterward, up to 2 stacks.
冲锋造成伤害提升至130% + 10% ATK。
Increases damage dealt by Temesia's charge to 130% + 10% ATK.
冲锋造成伤害提升至140% + 10% ATK。
Increases damage dealt by Temesia's charge to 140% + 10% ATK.
冲锋造成伤害提升至150% + 10% ATK。
Increases damage dealt by Temesia's charge to 150% + 10% ATK.
冲锋造成伤害提升至160% + 10% ATK。
Increases damage dealt by Temesia's charge to 160% + 10% ATK.
冲锋掉转方向时，对敌人造成伤害并使其造成伤害降低。
Temesia deals damage and reduces damage dealt by the enemy when charging in the opposite direction.
特弥希娅冲锋掉转方向时，使“晨曦”抬起后蹄对一名敌人踢击，造成150% + 15% ATK伤害和打断效果，并使其造成伤害降低15%，持续5秒。

Temesia commands her mount Dawn to kick an enemy while changing the charge direction, dealing 150% + 15% ATK damage and inflicting an interruption effect. Reduces the enemy's damage dealt by 15% for 5s.
特弥希娅冲锋掉转方向时，还会使自身回复10%的已损失生命值。
Restores 10% of lost HP when changing the charge direction.
冲锋时对自身范围的敌人造成基于对方攻击力的伤害。
Temesia deals damage to the surrounding enemies based on the targets' ATK.
特弥希娅冲锋时，挥舞双头大剑对自身1格范围的敌人造成4次对方攻击力40% + 5%伤害，每次伤害最高不超过自身70% + 7%的攻击力。
Temesia wields her broadsword to attack adjacent enemies four times while charging, dealing damage that is equal to 40% + 5% of the targets' ATK. Each damage doesn't exceed 70% + 7% of her ATK.
每次伤害提升至对方攻击力45% + 5%。
Each damage is increased to 45% + 5% of the targets' ATK.
每次伤害提升至对方攻击力50% + 5%。
Each damage is increased to 50% + 5% of the targets' ATK.
每次伤害提升至对方攻击力60% + 5%。
Each damage is increased to 60% + 5% of the targets' ATK.
提高自身攻击力，首次释放“骑士之心”后进一步提升攻击力。
Temesia's ATK increases during battle. She gains extra ATK after the first Knight's Heart cast.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升11%。且当首次释放“骑士之心”后，额外提升2%攻击力。
Temesia increases her ATK by 11% during battle. She also gains an extra 2% ATK the first time she casts Knight's Heart.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升14%。且当首次释放“骑士之心”后，额外提升3%攻击力。
Temesia increases her ATK by 14% during battle. She also gains an extra 3% ATK the first time she casts Knight's Heart.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升18%。且当首次释放“骑士之心”后，额外提升4%攻击力。
Temesia increases her ATK by 18% during battle. She also gains an extra 4% ATK the first time she casts Knight's Heart.
释放终极技能若干次后，自身永久免疫控制效果并且冲锋伤害变为真实伤害。
Temesia gains permanent control immunity and turns the charge damage into true damage after casting Ultimate several times.
释放“骑士之心”2次后，特弥希娅永久处于霸体状态，并且冲锋的伤害会变为真实伤害。
Temesia permanently becomes unaffected after casting Knight's Heart 2 times, turning the charge damage into true damage.
该状态下自身每秒回复1%的最大生命值。
Restores 1% of her max HP per second under this status.
该状态下自身每秒回复1.2%的最大生命值。
Restores 1.2% of her max HP per second under this status.
该状态下自身每秒回复1.4%的最大生命值。
Restores 1.4% of her max HP per second under this status.
“骑士之心”冲锋撞击到的敌人护甲降低。
Temesia reduces the enemy's Phys DEF if they are hit by Knight's Heart.
“骑士之心”冲锋撞击到的敌人护甲永久降低1%，最多叠加6次。
Reduces the enemy's Phys DEF by 1% when hit by Knight's Heart, up to 6 stacks.
特弥希娅在冲锋期间受到伤害降低30%，释放“铁骑飞蹄”时，额外对敌方造成其最大生命值30%的伤害，最高不超过自身600% ATK，并使自身获得300% ATK的护盾。

Temesia takes 30% less damage while charging. Her Iron Heel skill also deals extra damage equal to 30% of the target's max HP while granting her a 300% ATK shield. The extra damage cannot exceed 600% ATK.
